notes.title: Chastity Corruption! Sword Mistress of the Dungeon Town DEMO Now Available
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45353336/729367260b2330623d32dc4ffef581ac1cf25e56.png

【Dungeon Swordswoman】  
Add the game to your wishlist to get notified as soon as it launches!  
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3185540/_/?curator_clanid=45117199  

～ Story ～  
The city thriving on trading treasures from its many labyrinths.

Sword Mistress, after opposing the city's powerful chambers' guild, is burdened with massive debt and forced to sign a contract that condemns her to a life of sexual slavery if she fails to repay.

Under the pressure of needing to earn a large sum of money in a short period of time, some men took advantage of the situation and made inappropriate demands...

Can Sword Mistress achieve her goal without compromising her dignity and her body ?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45353336/d56adb366d4ba58ae8d3dc2953f8312a6ee9a2b8.jpg  
Opposing the influential guild, Reese cannot access city facilities.  
Her only available lodging is a den for desperate adventurers craving a woman’s body.  

From the innkeeper and merchants to other adventurers, everyone desires Reese’s body and her eggs.  
At first, even minor harassment angers her,  

but through dubious services offered under the guise of fundraising, her sense of chastity begins to wane…  

～ Characters ～  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45353336/cfabbb31db50f76818fc9ae2cabffc02cd7e6d8f.png
When Sword Mistress was a child, her family was deceived by the merchant guild, leading them into overwhelming debt and eventual ruin. 

Filled with hatred toward the guild, Sword Mistress vowed revenge. 

Relying on her exceptional swordsmanship talent, she became a vigilante thief, making a living by attacking the guild's caravans.

～ Gameplay ～  
◆ Had to do all kinds of jobs just to pay off the debt!

◆ Bar  
Sword Mistress works as a waitress...
At first it was just a bunny girl costume, but as the requirements became more and more exaggerated...
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45353336/e4f99f64b9c5de058fa74d81fc2b565d97daef53.jpg  

◆ Japanese Bathhouses  
Sword Mistress, forced to bathe with strangers to earn money...
Although she used a special concealment spell to cover her important parts, still...
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45353336/b343eee78b2a570e13cb41d3a75f9a87c3b75e56.jpg  

◆ Repayment Failure (BAD END)  
If she can't pay back the debt,

she’ll become the trading chamber's property, losing all her rights and everything else...
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45353336/5465aed4d81d4543de9d4790c2a53611411805b8.jpg  

～ System ～  

◆ Roguelike System  
Every time you enter the dungeon, the map, monsters, and dropped items are all random,

so each adventure is a completely new experience.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45353336/680d916ee3ea9086c158b70474b53aea6abd7c73.jpg
◆ Items  
Various items such as arrows, potions, scrolls, weapons, and chests appear randomly in the dungeon,

each with different additional abilities.

Besides being usable directly, some items can also be thrown to produce effects.

◆ Class and Skill Tree

You can learn skills based on your preferences.
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45117199/58d1d4e3536b714bcead226833701b9ceb54d0fd.png

───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

notes.title: Save the World Through Personality Correction! The Demo Version of Personality Excretion Hero Silvy's Rebirth is Now Available!
notes.content:
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45117199/4a0c508bf2b9f957f95bda98850fee565668f6ec.jpg

【Personality Excretion Hero Silvy's Rebirth】  
Add the game to your wishlist to get notified as soon as it launches!  
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3164910/_/?curator_clanid=42434109

～ Story ～

The ill-tempered hero, Sylvie, and her guardian, Kain,

Embark on a final battle against the Demon Lord to stop the "Wave of Destruction".



However, Kain is betrayed and sacrificed by Sylvie, his foster sister!

Through the miracle of the goddess, Kain is reborn and sent back to the past to begin the journey anew with his sister.

Will he exact revenge on the hero who betrayed him, or guide his sister to become a true hero?

The fate of Sylvie will drastically change based on the player’s choices!

～ Character ～

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45117199/f201fcaf291d87dabeb6471228f3d5561e10956c.png

Despite being chosen as the great hero to repel the "Wave of Destruction,"

Sylvie became arrogant and conceited after acquiring the power of the hero.

She’s so selfish that she even betrayed her only older brother,

making her universally despised across the kingdom.

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45117199/7ed07adb665588c08cecafef47f53399b84a409e.png

The protagonist of this story and Sylvie’s foster brother.

He has always protected Sylvie and was chosen as the "Guardian" to guide and protect the hero.

Once her most trusted person during childhood, he now seeks redemption or revenge.

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45117199/7c5b03d9149a9de1c2676f31b0ac3a1507d240f9.png

Princess of Ein Kingdom. A noble and virtuous princess who volunteers to join the party in their mission to repel the "Wave of Destruction."

She is honest and direct, with a strong aversion to unnecessary pretense or ambiguity.

However, her inexperience with emotions leaves her at a loss when faced with matters of the heart.

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45117199/c5290f480dc10801bf8c4076572ef6405e33b043.png

A legendary figure among the Four Sages, renowned for her exceptional intelligence and vast knowledge.

Despite her brilliance, she occasionally reveals a charmingly naive side.

She has an unmistakable fondness for the physiques of young men.

～ Gameplay ～

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45117199/c456de6ccf2d7dc5fe84d4f27c05772ee4f4ee11.jpg

Classic JRPG Gameplay

Battle your way through with a turn-based combat system.

Additionally, interact with NPCs to take on various quests, earn money, and buy equipment.



Affection Levels

Each character has their own affection level, which can be increased by giving them gifts.

When affection levels reach a certain point, you can even visit the clothing store to change female characters’ outfits.

Certain game endings also require high affection levels to unlock.



Karma Points

A crucial stat that influences the game’s ending.

Helping others by completing quests reduces karma points.

Try guiding Silvy into becoming a true hero!

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45117199/a92b901aea9bf4ccaeb7193f3f7578ad55bf8965.png

Personality Excretion

One of the core themes of the game, Personality Excretion allows characters to purge negative traits from their soul.

While performing Personality Excretion can significantly reduce Karma Points, it also lowers the character’s Rationality.

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45117199/c456de6ccf2d7dc5fe84d4f27c05772ee4f4ee11.jpg

Rationality

Low rationality affects how H events play out.

All H events have two variations: one for normal rationality and another for low rationality, allowing players to explore different scenarios.
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45117199/58d1d4e3536b714bcead226833701b9ceb54d0fd.png

notes.title: 【The Misadventures of Magical Girl Luna】 The store page is now open! Join the (physically) magical girl on an adventure to explore this wondrous world!
notes.content:
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45117199/04251c2ca5a27ff053e13976a79d41ac3bbc0575.jpg

【The Misadventures of Magical Girl Luna】  
Add the game to your wishlist to get notified as soon as it launches!  
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3413490/_/

～ Story ～

Welcome to a world where magic and technology exist side by side.

Luna, raised under the loving yet strict guidance of the great magician Sol, has grown into a capable magical girl (!?).

With her innocent and romantic outlook, Luna sets off on an unbelievable adventure,

facing all kinds of challenges along the way—

Her journey starts now!

～ Character ～

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45117199/4dc381c92ef86caf8a0f57ab9a346c1dda728be1.png

Trained by Sol with both love and discipline, Luna’s now a skilled magical girl.

She may look small, but don’t let her size fool you—she’s got strength that rivals adults!

She’s the type to charge ahead without much thinking.

[Sol: "Being energetic is great… but if she could think things through a bit more, that’d be even better."]

～ Gameplay ～

◆Battles

Special Battle Dialogues!

Immerse yourself in the story as you battle!

Discover enemies’ weaknesses and gain deeper insight into their personalities mid-fight!

[Sol: "The best way to beat an enemy is to understand them first."]



◆Post-Battle Tips

If Luna loses, Sol will step in with advice and strategies to help you win next time!

[Sol:" Don’t give up if you fail—failure is the stepping stone to success. I believe in you, Luna!"]

h2]～ Game Features[ ～

◆Battle

Even if you lose, you can collect exclusive stamps!

After clearing the game, you can unlock bonus illustrations and other content. Explore everywhere for surprises!

[Sol: "After clearing the game, take some time to roam around. You might find something cool!"]



◆Collectibles

Everything on the map (not just shiny objects!) can be investigated!

You might stumble upon something valuable… or unusual!

[Sol: "While she loves picking up random things… sometimes they turn out to be surprisingly useful."]



◆Items

Anything Luna picks up along the way (yes, anything) can become a weapon!

Each item has unique effects.

You can use them directly or throw them at enemies for special results!

[Sol: "Well… it’s kind of her thing, but hey, it works!"]



◆Casino

Test Your Luck: “What’s life without a little risk?”

Race Against Time: “Is me, little Luna~⭐”

Chase Enemies: "Ora ora ora!"

No matter your playstyle, the casino’s got something for everyone.

Aim for the ultimate reward: the Platinum Star!

And rumor has it, Platinum-level players get access to a hidden secret…

[Sol: "Wait, when did she even go there…?"]
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45117199/2cbf80c80678ff8f11de5d39a22852c201dd1290.jpg


───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
~ COMING SOON ~

【Please pay the rent!】  
Add the game to your wishlist to get notified as soon as it launches!  
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3340210/_/?curator_clanid=45117199

～ Story ～  
You are a man who stumbled upon success through an unexpected investment.

Your days are leisurely and carefree, with little to worry about financially aside from managing your real estate properties.

One day, however, your peaceful life is disrupted by the arrival of two letters—both from your tenants.

This unusual occurrence sparks your curiosity and raises questions.

Determined to uncover what’s going on, you decide to visit their residence in person.

When you arrive and push open the door, the sight before you takes you by surprise—your two tenants are elegant, refined women, exuding a graceful demeanor.

Despite the seemingly tranquil facade, subtle hints of unease and unspoken troubles linger in their expressions, drawing you in to learn more.

The core objective of this story is simple: by conversing with these two tenants, uncover the details of their lives, delve into the challenges they face, and reveal the truths hidden beneath their composed exteriors.

～ Characters ～  

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45117199/bb2a5a6f8254ca3180eae6a35b0eefdef5fc5fef.png

Kyoko is all about coffee.

She’s obsessed with crafting the perfect cup, pouring her heart and soul into every brew.

To her, coffee isn’t just a drink—it’s her sanctuary.

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45117199/0f858c37fab7669fb8b9e8e5d566a8781036c570.png

Saori is sweet, bubbly, and effortlessly approachable.

She’s the kind of person who’s always ready to help, sometimes to the point of being taken advantage of.

Whenever you visit, she greets you with a warm smile and an array of snacks—cookies, cakes, you name it. It’s clear she has a major sweet tooth!

Her natural charm and striking appearance often draw attention, especially her… well, let’s just say her curves don’t go unnoticed. But Saori herself seems completely oblivious to the effect she has on others.

～ Gameplay ～  

This game is a visual novel where you can freely explore your apartment and the homes of your two tenants.

In this story, you’ll take on the challenge of developing relationships with your tenants, starting from mutual disdain and progressing toward subtle romance.

Through engaging in conversations with them, you’ll gradually unlock more of their stories and secrets, gaining a deeper understanding of each tenant's unique circumstances.

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45353336/729367260b2330623d32dc4ffef581ac1cf25e56.png

【Dungeon Swordswoman】  
Add the game to your wishlist to get notified as soon as it launches!  
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3185540/_/?curator_clanid=45117199  

～ Story ～  
The city thriving on trading treasures from its many labyrinths.

Sword Mistress, after opposing the city's powerful chambers' guild, is burdened with massive debt and forced to sign a contract that condemns her to a life of sexual slavery if she fails to repay.

Under the pressure of needing to earn a large sum of money in a short period of time, some men took advantage of the situation and made inappropriate demands...

Can Sword Mistress achieve her goal without compromising her dignity and her body ?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45353336/d56adb366d4ba58ae8d3dc2953f8312a6ee9a2b8.jpg  
Opposing the influential guild, Reese cannot access city facilities.  
Her only available lodging is a den for desperate adventurers craving a woman’s body.  

From the innkeeper and merchants to other adventurers, everyone desires Reese’s body and her eggs.  
At first, even minor harassment angers her,  

but through dubious services offered under the guise of fundraising, her sense of chastity begins to wane…  

～ Characters ～  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45353336/cfabbb31db50f76818fc9ae2cabffc02cd7e6d8f.png
When Sword Mistress was a child, her family was deceived by the merchant guild, leading them into overwhelming debt and eventual ruin. 

Filled with hatred toward the guild, Sword Mistress vowed revenge. 

Relying on her exceptional swordsmanship talent, she became a vigilante thief, making a living by attacking the guild's caravans.

～ Gameplay ～  
◆ Had to do all kinds of jobs just to pay off the debt!

◆ Bar  
Sword Mistress works as a waitress...
At first it was just a bunny girl costume, but as the requirements became more and more exaggerated...
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45353336/e4f99f64b9c5de058fa74d81fc2b565d97daef53.jpg  

◆ Japanese Bathhouses  
Sword Mistress, forced to bathe with strangers to earn money...
Although she used a special concealment spell to cover her important parts, still...
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45353336/b343eee78b2a570e13cb41d3a75f9a87c3b75e56.jpg  

◆ Repayment Failure (BAD END)  
If she can't pay back the debt,

she’ll become the trading chamber's property, losing all her rights and everything else...
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45353336/5465aed4d81d4543de9d4790c2a53611411805b8.jpg  

～ System ～  

◆ Roguelike System  
Every time you enter the dungeon, the map, monsters, and dropped items are all random,

so each adventure is a completely new experience.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45353336/680d916ee3ea9086c158b70474b53aea6abd7c73.jpg
◆ Items  
Various items such as arrows, potions, scrolls, weapons, and chests appear randomly in the dungeon,

each with different additional abilities.

Besides being usable directly, some items can also be thrown to produce effects.

◆ Class and Skill Tree

You can learn skills based on your preferences.

notes.title: 《Hybrislave》 has been officially released!
notes.content:
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42434109/619316eb9b5d6e7753262129c286b68c0654782d.png

《Hybrislave》 is a short RPG game developed by "触手折檻部屋", this is a prologue in nature, the future will be released in a larger story!


◆Story

Once upon a time, the sudden appearance of monsters called "Burana" invaded human territory, and a war between humans and Burana broke out. 
Many men were killed and women were raped, but after a long battle, humans finally sealed the gate to the Makai. 
However, the losses suffered by various countries were enormous, and they are still struggling to rebuild their countries. 
Many areas still lack basic infrastructure, and the Burana that have survived in various places are breeding and continuing to survive...

　――This is the story of a girl living in such a world.

◆Concept

This work mainly depicts a story of "the protagonist being strong and unyielding even after experiencing harsh hardships".

Although this is a very short story, every erotic scene is extreme and relentless!


◆Character Introduction

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42434109/2ac9a4f084cd289305485c3445eac374b1f14238.png
Raira
The protagonist of this work. 
She is a lively and energetic girl. 
For some reason, she lives in an orphanage and works hard to solve the problems of the village. 
Although she looks no different from humans, she is actually called a "mixed race" and has both human and Burana bloodlines, she hides this fact.

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42434109/4ec5022ecb9cc22ce6ed8ddebc3f1d168aea8cc0.png
Risha
A nun who manages the orphanage. 
For Raira, she is like her older sister. 
Since the war with Burana, the subsidy has decreased, and she has had to resort to emergency management. 
And her way of earning money is...


◆Game Features
Classic RPG game style
There are 3 types of Endings
Quickly unlock all the erotic scenes in the memory room

Story
A pair of childhood friends accidentally broke into another world "Kakuriyo Village" when they got lost. 
And there is only one way to get out of here. 
That is, after the annual "Summer Commences", "Kakuriyo Village" will open its entrance to welcome foreign guests. As long as the people trapped here "grow" during this year, it will make the Kekkai mistakenly think that they do not belong to the residents of the village because of "self-change". At this time, just pray with the guardian Miko and you will be free to leave.

Can you successfully get them both out of this mysterious village?

Game Feature
Explore freely in the village
Map with quest markers
Learn about the villagers' stories
Immersive plot experience without combat system

 "Araka~JK Exorcist Horror RPG"
It is a horror-style RPG game developed by the well-known Japanese fan club "I'm moralist", and it is announced that it will be published by BokiBoki Games!

+

The other world, which was supposed to be investigated by the Exorcist Association, is a very cruel world for female exorcists.
It is so powerful that it would take five experienced male exorcists to seal it away.
The exorcist girl Araka was trapped in such a bad world.

"I won't lose—!"

Nevertheless, Araka did not give up for the sake of her loved ones.
However, in this evil alien world that tries to deprive people of their dignity, does Araka, who is fighting alone, have any way of self-salvation?
-
──Araka has been missing for two months.
For you who have little experience in exorcism, the only thing you can rely on is your unique natural psionic ability.
Can you save Araka from this vicious world?

notes.title: "Talent Club ~ Match 3 Puzzle" is officially released!
notes.content:
-10% off the first week of release!
"Talent Club ~ Match 3 Puzzle" is a puzzle-type bead-rolling game developed by Ex-Erotia and published by BokiBoki Games.
Players need to defeat each club's minister in a match-3 game in a social university club.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43132620/edc92bd502a0f81f6bbed7c23feb778d0d872551.png

Basic gameplay
If the player completes the elimination and the opponent fails to eliminate it, they will be attacked.
Eliminate 5 fragments at the same time, then it will automatically generate fragments of the color of our party or the opponent.
Shards of different colors have different functions, which can restore HP or launch additional attacks.
Using skills can also cause damage to the opponent.

Game Features
Turn-based elimination game
Special props and skills
Have full voice

For more game news, please follow BokiBoki Games!
